claims.text: A CNN-based sentence classifier achieved the best results in all three sub-tasks.
The CNN outperformed the RNN model, achieving a macro-F1 score of 0.80.
In the experiment comparing insults and threats, the CNN system achieved higher performance than the BiLSTM.
